[B1] < deviceB | 'key' : Key , ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB
=> < deviceB | 'key' : Key , ... > $ deviceB 'sendDeviceKey' UserX | Key .
[B1] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > $ deviceB 'sendDeviceKey' UserX | Key
=> < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > .
[B2] < cloudA | deviceB : ('bindingKey' : Key , 'owners' : Owners , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'bindDevice' cloudA | (deviceB ; Key)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('bindingKey' : Key , 'owners' : (UserX , Owners) , ...) , ... > .
[B3] < cloudA | UserX : ('devices' : nils , 'members' : Members , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | UserY
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('devices' : nils , 'members' : (UserY , Members) , ...) , ... > .
[B4] < cloudA | UserX : ('devices' : nils , 'members' : (UserY , Members) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'removeMember' cloudA | UserY
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('devices' : nils , 'members' : Members , ...) , ... > .
[B5] < UserX | 'near' : OldNear , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > .
[B6] < UserX | 'near' : OldNear , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
